features.zh: 提供 Server、GNOME 和 XFCE 三种 ARM64 Linux 镜像。
features.en: Provide Server, GNOME and XFCE ARM64 Linux images.

features.zh: 集成本地构建的 Chromium、MPP/RGA/NPU 运行库以及 Fcitx5/Rime 中文输入支持。
features.en: Integrate locally built Chromium, MPP/RGA/NPU libraries and Fcitx5/Rime Chinese input support.

features.zh: 在 ARM64 上构建 rootfs，使用 SDK 打包工具生成完整可烧录 update.img。
features.en: Build rootfs natively on ARM64 and produce complete flashable update.img files with the SDK pack tools.

fixes.zh: 修正 GNOME 输入法面板提示，并禁用默认空闲息屏。
fixes.en: Correct the GNOME input-method panel notification and disable idle screen blanking by default.

fixes.zh: 为 XFCE 显式选择认证代理，避免网络管理组件带入 GNOME Shell。
fixes.en: Select an explicit authentication agent for XFCE to prevent network management dependencies from pulling in GNOME Shell.

improvements.zh: 默认登录 Shell 使用 Bash，首次启动通过英文提示创建管理员账号。
improvements.en: Use Bash as the default login shell and create the administrator account through English first-boot prompts.

improvements.zh: 每种镜像附带 SHA256 校验文件和源码、二进制输入构建记录。
improvements.en: Include SHA256 checksums and source/binary-input build receipts for every image.

other.zh: U-Boot、kernel、DEB、KO 等二进制输入通过附件上传，不提交到 Git。
other.en: Upload U-Boot, kernel, DEB and KO binary inputs as attachments rather than committing them to Git.

other.zh: 版本发布使用语义化标签；构建成功与实机验收结果分别记录。
other.en: Use semantic version tags for releases and record build success separately from physical board acceptance.
